title: Iran: six dated statements, from Senate to State Department
kicker: Iran · Senate record and Secretary of State record
dek: Six dated statements show what Marco Rubio said as a senator and later as Secretary of State. The roll call below records one Iran-related Senate vote; it does not itself answer whether any statement and vote are consistent.

key_votes.text: on moving forward with a measure to bar sanctions relief under an Iran nuclear agreement.

statements.quote: we won't just reverse President Obama's dangerous Iran deal. We will increase sanctions on Iran.
statements.highlight: We will increase sanctions on Iran

statements.venue: U.S. senator and presidential candidate · public statement

statements.quote: We’ve always said it’s hard, but we’re going to try. That’s what the President is trying. I’m not going to prejudge those talks.

statements.quote: The negotiations tomorrow and the talks tomorrow will be largely focused on the nuclear program, and we hope progress can be made because that’s the President’s preference: to make progress on the diplomatic front.
